target.title: docs: fix pnpm global install build approval
target.body:
Closes #106166

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users following the pnpm global install instructions would hit `[ERR_PNPM_APPROVE_BUILDS_NOT_SUPPORTED_WITH_GLOBAL]` when running `pnpm approve-builds -g`. Because that command fails, the required build step could remain unapproved.

## Why This Change Was Made

pnpm no longer supports `approve-builds -g` for isolated global packages. The install command now uses pnpm's supported `--allow-build=openclaw` option, while local source-checkout instructions that use `pnpm approve-builds` without `-g` remain unchanged.

## User Impact

Users can follow the pnpm global install instructions without encountering the unsupported-command error, including through the localized install pages generated from this source.

## Evidence

- pnpm's current `approve-builds` documentation explicitly directs global installs to use `--allow-build`.
- The `pnpm add` reference documents `--allow-build` for authorizing install scripts.
- The final diff changes only `docs/install/index.md` and passes `git show --check`.
- Local docs formatting could not run because this isolated checkout does not have the `oxfmt` dependency installed; CI remains the format gate.
